# Minimum allowed Go coverage by package directory.
# Format: <package-path> <minimum-percent>
#         <package-path> -                    # excluded (no statements)
# Lines beginning with # and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Enforced by scripts/check-go-coverage-ratchet.sh (run from build-test.yml
# after the total-coverage ratchet). Package coverage may rise above these
# floors, but must never drop below them. When it rises, follow the
# ::notice:: printed by CI and update the floor in a follow-up ratchet PR.
#
# A threshold of "-" (or "none") marks a package as intentionally excluded
# from per-package enforcement because it has no coverable statements —
# e.g. an ldflag-target var block. See kubestellar-mcp#872.
#
# See kubestellar-mcp#802 for background: the total-only 95% floor in
# .github/go-coverage-ratchet.txt masked pkg/deploy/mcp at 94%.
